test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Stop __beating around the bush__ and tell me what is expected out of me.

options.text: avoiding to talk about the issue

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"beating around the bush"** means avoiding to talk about the main issue or topic. (मुद्दे से बचना)

 
 
• **Example: **Instead of **beating around the bush**, he should get straight to the point.
 
 

 
• **"Avoiding to talk about the issue"** means deliberately not discussing the main topic or problem. (मुद्दे के बारे में बात करने से बचना)

 
 
• **Example: **She kept **avoiding to talk about the issue**, making it difficult to find a solution.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Revealing a secret to everyone **(सभी को एक रहस्य बताना): Making a confidential piece of information known to many people.

 
 
• **Example:** By revealing a secret to everyone, he broke their trust.
 
 
 
• **Misunderstanding the situation **(स्थिति को गलत समझना): Not correctly understanding what is happening.
 
 
• **Example: **He ended up misunderstanding the situation and reacted inappropriately.
 
 
 
• **Getting the conversation going** (बातचीत शुरू करना): Initiating or maintaining a discussion.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very good at getting the conversation going at social gatherings.
 
 

1cd:Tbed,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
